characterGuideline.decisionSummary: 入力画像0件の独自生成ファンアートとして使用し、非公式であることとcreditを表示する。第三者配布素材や公式画像の再利用はない。

credit: 宮沢賢治ずんだもん：OpenAI built-in image_genによる独自生成（入力画像なし）

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: square author card illustration for a Japanese literature web app
Primary request: Create an original chibi illustration of a cheerful green bean-themed mascot reimagined as a gentle early-20th-century Japanese poet and naturalist, evoking the atmosphere of Kenji Miyazawa without copying any real photograph or identifiable face.
Scene/backdrop: warm aged washi-paper texture with a loose circular ink-wash halo; subtle tiny star and wildflower motifs, no landscape.
Subject: one fictional mascot character only; bright leaf-green hair with two rounded bean-pod buns; large amber eyes; modest dark navy travel coat over a cream shirt, small burgundy bow tie, simple dark hat held under one arm, and a slim book in the other hand.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn anime chibi illustration, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture, clean dark outlines, visually compatible with a literary character card.
Composition/framing: centered three-quarter portrait from knees upward, generous padding, square composition.
Lighting/mood: soft warm diffuse light, kind, curious, literary, whimsical.
Color palette: parchment beige, leaf green, navy, cream, burgundy, muted gray ink.
Constraints: entirely original generated image; no input or reference image; no depiction or tracing of Kenji Miyazawa or any real person; no copyrighted third-party character costume or logo; no text; no signature; no watermark.
Avoid: photorealism, exact human likeness, military insignia, recognizable brand marks, extra people, distorted hands, extra fingers, cropped head, neon background.

providerTerms.decisionSummary: built-in image_genによる入力画像なし生成物の利用に関するprovider termsを選定時確認した。

generation.recipe: Generated with OpenAI built-in image_gen using the prompt above and zero input/reference images; no post-generation image edit, compositing, inpainting, third-party asset insertion, text, logo, or watermark; the generated PNG was copied byte-for-byte to the F002 tracked public-files source.

humanReview.reviewer: Project owner blanket approval (2026-07-20) / Codex visual inspection (2026-07-25)
humanReview.summary: 画像は前セッションで会話に表示され、プロジェクトオーナーは作業全体を包括承認した。2026-07-25のCodex実物目視では、1人の架空chibi、豆さや髪、紺コート、帽子、本、和紙・星・草花を確認し、文字、署名、watermark、logo、写真風の実在人物顔、第三者素材由来の識別要素は見当たらず、手指も自然だった。個別の人手による画像確認はT-029/QTで再確認する。
